title.narrative: Mejoramiento de la Educacin y Formacin Tcnico Profesional
Technical Vocational Education and Training Improvement

description.narrative: El objetivo principal es mejorar la cobertura, calidad y pertinencia de la Educacin y Formacin Tcnico Profesional (EFTP) con el fin de desarrollar habilidades de empleabilidad de los jvenes. Especficamente, se busca: (i)expandir la oferta de EFTP a travs de inversiones en infraestructura, equipamiento y capacitacin docente; (ii)fortalecer la investigacin e innovacin aplicada; y(iii) promover la vinculacin con el mundo de trabajo.

The program's main objective is to improve the coverage, quality, and relevance of technical vocational education and training (TVET), with a view to developing young people's employability skills.The specific objectives are to: (i) expand TVET supply through investments in infrastructure, equipment, and teacher training; (ii) strengthen applied research and innovation; and (iii) forge links with the world of work.
